scenario: Weekly Payout Dispatch → Sheets Log + Rep Notifications
description: Fires at the end of each week after payout calculations are ready for Evan's review. Make.com logs the full payout breakdown to the Payouts Google Sheet, sends each rep their individual cut via Discord DM, and posts a weekly summary to the staff finance channel.

payload.weekStart: string — YYYY-MM-DD start of the pay week

payouts.staffDiscordId: string | null — Discord user ID for direct DM
payouts.amount: number — total payout amount in USD

deals.cut: number — rep's cut for this deal
deals.ad: boolean — true if lead source was 'ad'

payload.totalGMV: number — total gross revenue collected this week
payload.timestamp: string — ISO 8601 timestamp when cron ran

makeSteps: Step 1: Receive webhook — parse payout breakdown
Step 2: Append row to Payouts Google Sheet (one row per rep per week)
Step 3: Loop through payouts array — send each rep a Discord DM with their breakdown
Step 4: Post weekly summary to staff finance Discord channel
Step 5: (Optional) Send Evan a confirmation that all rep notifications were dispatched
